scope: Typed immutable autosave ownership and legacy-cache preservation; explicit cold restore and public immutable creation remain disabled
properties: Constant-size capture retains exact immutable source, session incarnation and revision without materialization
Durable writes run outside the state lock; bounded bindings retain weak source references and exact file leases
Stale captures cannot overwrite newer durable revisions; bookkeeping records only the successfully captured revision
Transient write refusal stays pending while unrelated documents and assembly autosave continue
Pending, corrupt or unavailable typed records shadow old part restore, prune and close cleanup without touching their bytes
Pending typed records also refuse compatibility part and workspace-head writes or unlink while retaining independent assembly autosave
First durable bytes survive a later failed or closed host publication; saved records confer no host authority
remaining: Explicit recovery status and cold restore through the existing bounded job owner
Host-only restore admission and exact candidate publication permit
Durable first creation serialized against an already-admitted compatibility autosave
Full durable create, restart, restore, edit and flush lifecycle qualification before the public storage switch
No assertion that moving decode and I/O outside the shared lock eliminates Python/GIL latency
artifacts: Only pytest-owned temporary directories and small sentinel files; no application lifespan, background cache thread or user workspace
